name: Florida

agency.name: Florida Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Water Resource Management, Oil and Gas Program

form.name: Application for Permit to Drill (Oil & Gas Form 3)
form.notes: One-page form, read in full. Filed with an Organization Report (Form 1), performance security, a surveyor plat, site construction plans, a casing and cementing program, a contingency plan where applicable and a $2,000 fee (rule 62C-26.003, read on Cornell LII). The form has no field for well type, work type, lease, formation, depth plan, BOP, H2S, water, pits or fracturing, so those are none or unknown. The bottom line is agency use: file number, action, date, API number.

well_name.n: WELL_NAME; form asks "Well Name and Number"

lease_name.n: Form 3 asks well name and field, no lease or unit name

operator_id.n: Form 3 has no operator ID; Organization Report (Form 1) not read

bond.n: Form 3 asks the security type and its serial number; not in the workbook

district.n: No district on Form 3 or in the workbook

surface_latlon.n: LATITUDE, LONGITUDE (decimal and DMS); form asks both

surface_plss.n: STR, QSEC and SHL footages; form asks Sec/Twp/Rge for SHL and BHL

bottom_hole_loc.n: BHL = footage from unit boundary (or SAME); no BH coordinates

lateral_path.n: Form 3 asks no survey or path

surface_owner.n: Not on Form 3; plat contents not read

well_type.n: No purpose column; only via CURRENT_STATUS (PROD, INJ, SWD...)

work_type.n: Form 3 and the workbook carry no work type

well_direction.n: Not asked; BHL "SAME" only hints at a vertical well

proposed_depth_md.n: Form asks "Proposed Depth"; file MD/TVD are as drilled

proposed_depth_tvd.n: File TVD column is the drilled wellbore; planned TVD not seen

target_formation.n: Form 3 asks Field/Area only, no target formation

casing_program.n: COND/SURF/INT/PROD_CSG and TUBING as size at depth; rule 62C-26.003 requires a program

cement_program.n: Rule 62C-26.003: program with cement class and quantity; not a workbook column

frac_dates.n: Form 8 has workover from-to dates only; the workover rule asks for no frac job date

frac_chemicals.n: No Florida statute or rule found requiring frac chemical disclosure; the workover rule does not mention it

frac_additives.n: Nothing found requires additive names; Form 8's stimulation record has only a free-text comments column

frac_amounts.n: Nothing found requires ingredient amounts; Form 8's stimulation record has only a free-text comments column

spacing_unit.n: Form asks acres assigned and distance to unit boundary; file has SHL/BHL footage only

mineral_owner.n: Form asks if all mineral interest is leased; lease map and nonconsenting owners attached

fee.n: $2,000 processing fee, rule 62C-26.003(8); not on Form 3 itself

notice_hearing.n: Notice to working interest owners (s. 377.2411); local permits and contingency plan near waters

date_approved.n: ISSUE_DATE = date final authority signed the permit (Excel serial)

plat_image.n: DOCUMENTS column links a per-permit document list (Oculus); contents not checked

form_image.n: DOCUMENTS column links a per-permit document list (Oculus); contents not checked

completion_report.n: DOCUMENTS column links a per-permit document list (Oculus); contents not checked

logs.n: WELL_LOGS lists log types received, not the logs

production_link.n: Separate well production files by year (2012-present) on the Oil and Gas Data page

sources.name: Oil and Gas Permit Database (OG_WELLS_WEBSITE_4.xlsx, tab WELLS)

grade_reason: A free, reachable 0.7 MB workbook with one row per permit and an ISSUE_DATE (final agency action) plus spud and completion dates. But Florida issues almost no permits: the latest ISSUE_DATE in the file is 2020-03-04, with 19 in 2019, and 4 or fewer a year 2014-2018, so monthly counts are near zero.
producer_plan: Download OG_WELLS_WEBSITE_4.xlsx, read the WELLS tab, convert ISSUE_DATE (Excel serial) to a date and count rows by month. A decimal PERMITNO (1335.1) is a later modification of the same permit: count it as "amend", whole numbers as new permits. Drop rows with no ISSUE_DATE (never drilled, pending, denied) or show them as pending. Injection and disposal wells can be split out only through CURRENT_STATUS (INJ, SWD). The file changes quarterly, so check its last-modified header. Expect a near-empty series since March 2020: the national report should say "no permits issued since March 2020" rather than show zeros as a trend.
privacy_notes: The workbook has company names (COMPANY) and a free-text COMMENTS column marked for intra-office use; check it before publishing. Form 3 has a signer with a residential address, not published in the workbook.
